name: dchub
description: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Agents can query it and cite it: live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, interconnection queues, electricity prices, fiber and site analysis. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. The free tier needs no key; an optional DC Hub key can be sent as an X-API-Key header.

examples.title: Rank markets for power
examples.prompt: Which US markets have the best DCPI score for a 50 MW AI data center right now?

examples.title: Analyze a site
examples.description: Get a siting read for a location
examples.prompt: Analyze a data-center site near Abilene, Texas: power, interconnection queue and fiber.

examples.title: Grid conditions
examples.prompt: What are current ERCOT grid conditions and wholesale prices?
